title: Match capitals: Western Asia
intro: Match each country in Western Asia with its capital city.

pairs.explain: Abu Dhabi is the capital of United Arab Emirates.
Yerevan is the capital of Armenia.
Nicosia is the capital of Cyprus.
Tbilisi is the capital of Georgia.
Baghdad is the capital of Iraq.
Kuwait City is the capital of Kuwait.
Beirut is the capital of Lebanon.
Riyadh is the capital of Saudi Arabia.
